title: Warren County Farmers' Fair featuring the Balloon Festival

services.name: Balloon Festival
services.desc: (Note, tethered rides are first come first served and tickets are only sold on site.) The Balloon Festival at the Warren County Farmers' Fair, in Warren County, New Jersey, alone is worth the trip! If you have never experienced the thrill of watching a bevy of colorful hot air balloons majestically rise from green pasture to blue sky, you can't imagine what you're missing. And if you're inclined to adventure, you can buy a ticket, hop on board and join the fun close-up! For more details on the balloon festival visit www.balloonfestnj.com. For information on scheduling a balloon ride at the hot air balloon festival or during the year, email info@balloonfestnj.com or visit
